comments.body: Thanks! I do think that we should keep all characters rather than truncating and hence switch the field to a `TextField` that's not limited to 1024 character. I don't see why we need to enforce the 1024 limit.

Agreed, this keeps the full command line. Pushed a commit that changes `Run.cli_args` to an unbounded `TextField` (migration `0194_alter_run_cli_args`) and removes the truncation helper and its test. The regression checks that the field is an unbounded TextField and that ln.track() stores a >1024-character command line unchanged (passes on a local SQLite instance; fails on main). Since the PR now changes the schema rather than truncating, the title and description are updated accordingly.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
